mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.iot_device_status FROM bbx_ioc_device d INNER JOIN bbx_device_group_rel dgr ON d.id = dgr.device_id INNER JOIN bbx_device_group dg ON dgr.group_id = dg.id AND dg.group_code like CONCAT('%',#{groupCode},'%') AND dg.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dg.deleted = 1 WHERE d.enable_status = 1 AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = 1
